name: env-vars
title: The environment variables, as documented and as read
description: The help and both READMEs tell a user to set environment variables - DOVE_PI_DISABLE_SESSION_AFFINITY, PI_CACHE_RETENTION, HTTPS_PROXY and others - and the code reads its own set. A variable a document names and nothing reads is a knob that does nothing, and a variable the code reads that no document names is one nobody can find
creator: aixi
